exophase.name: Exophase - Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
exophase.usedFor: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades for all 55 trophies, checked live 2026-11-20

powerpyx.name: PowerPyx - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
powerpyx.usedFor: How to earn each trophy: roadmap, counts, locations, mission names and missable warnings

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles - Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
psnprofiles.usedFor: Cross-check of the official list and PSN progress counts; the kit's frozen list agrees with Exophase on every name, description and grade

trophies.guide: It unlocks the instant the other 54 are done — no multiplayer or DLC is involved. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous clean-up. PowerPyx puts the whole run at 4/10 and roughly 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it arrives after the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. There is nothing to do but keep playing.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 2. According to PowerPyx it lands after the first mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 3. Per PowerPyx it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 4. PowerPyx says it unlocks after the final Chapter 4 mission, 'Starting From Zero'.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: For the final mission — the same 'Starting From Zero' finale, per PowerPyx. Finish the story and it is yours; free-roam opens right after, so nothing gets locked away.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 mission 'Breakfast Run' and it pops during the mission, per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 mission 'The Cartel Heist'.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 mission 'Child's Play'.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 mission 'Headliners'.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 mission 'VCIA Takedown'.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 5 mission 'Operation Savage Glory', per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Hit 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only opens after the story — though progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and collectibles are mostly partial — scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish 70 of 80 challenges. The only things that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, per PowerPyx. You can mix categories; under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt (PowerPyx). Check them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You will do most of them naturally while chasing other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges, per PowerPyx. The gold medals here are not too hard, and range practice also levels your Focus, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx. Every location is required for the 100% checklist too, so this comes with the clean-up.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx maps 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones you like best — car races, race challenges and drone races all count as race wins, but this trophy wants 20 distinct ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', when you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge, per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games ('Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck, per PowerPyx. The first three are on the TV at home (Chapter 1 onwards); the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3, Andy calls Lucia and texts her address in Belville; the line stays available after the story. Finish her 5 quests — 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (parts 1-3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label' and 'Puff Puff Pass' — and the final one pops the trophy (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving line, marked automatically in Chapter 1; he calls after the 'Island Dreams' mission and is marked 'KR' in Key Lento. Clear his 7 shipwrecks, bringing the treasures back to his shop, using the metal detector on the ocean floor. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing here is missable (PowerPyx). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's line, marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests — 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' and 'Hometown Heroes' — and the last one pops it (PowerPyx). Still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Note that not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, per PowerPyx. Confirmed counters include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); more are still being found, and everything stays available after the story. Watch the counter in the trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, and deliver them in good condition for better pay (PowerPyx). Doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line, Jason-only, marked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'. Destroy the Synthetic Labs (purple markers, quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter'), then Tyrone hands you the second quest, 'Spin On This' — finishing it pops the trophy (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2 (PowerPyx). THE missable one: during Chapter 1, after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she walks to the balcony to meditate; follow her and accept. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether it counts toward the trophy, so do it to be safe. Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line, Jason-only. After the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', Bret texts Jason and marks 'Veteran Hunted' in Lummox County. He gives you the 'Killtelligence SM-69' hunting rifle and marks hunting spots; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back. PowerPyx notes all 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally — the exact animal that pops it is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx maps 18 card set locations, so you have plenty of choice — pick the three easiest sets and finish them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1). There are far more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, per PowerPyx — so scan whatever you pass. It also feeds the vehicle and discovery counts.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. Track them under Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest ones left for last — most complete naturally while you work on other trophies (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Available after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' (call your partner with Right + Triangle). PowerPyx's easy method: drive the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' when bank vaults hand you 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between shops. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3): loot a couple of items and the back-room safe in each, and if it does not pop after the third, hit a fourth. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the last shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — just scan them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) as they drive past; you do not need to drive them. Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 scanned, so this pops early (PowerPyx). Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). Buff your focus first — eat, drink, shower at home — and pop Adrenaline to stretch the slow-mo, then line up 5 enemies with an assault rifle like the Duke 556 (PowerPyx). Criminals at gang operations work; it does not seem to trigger on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal — the ones on the open airfield do not count. PowerPyx's easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4; drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, get in the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive in (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until it pops (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' to unlock the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm (PowerPyx). Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. It starts with the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...': tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more vans (finish his Payday Loans jobs first). All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway, and each pays up to $205,000 (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal — tailing the truck to a bank counts. Or do it early: block a truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it, then escape the red heat radius (PowerPyx). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist, but one per gang is enough for the trophy (all 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way). They show as yellow icons when you get near them; track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it standing next to the bar with the view — that is the whole trophy (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (PowerPyx). Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (sticky bombs open it). PowerPyx notes it unlocks after you escape the police, and if you miss one during the Chapter 2 mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling', the robbery icon respawns later — not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs (filter Activities on the map) and always bring your partner — while one trains, the other finishes their training too, so you progress twice as fast (PowerPyx). Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia. Only possible after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when you can switch between both characters.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — robberies, clean escapes, destroying evidence, fights, all of it counts. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see the demon-face icon when an action registers, and check your count by opening the trophy in the list (PowerPyx). It accrues passively through every other trophy.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: during the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store — go back later and rob the same store again as Lucia, alone, then escape on foot. Earliest chance is after the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check', which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. PowerPyx pins the store to Little Cuba in Vice City; the pop is delayed until you have run clear of the search area — driving away will not count.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. After 2AM, alone, drive the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside — the spawn is slightly random, so drive away and come back if it is not there. Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, and help the woman it drops off by going back to her car (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach make it easy (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts — cumulative, not all at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most (PowerPyx). Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 per job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest routes since they are the priciest; Leonida has 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops and more (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count) for $160,000 total. They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver' — buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (PowerPyx). Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the fastest money.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses; then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn, hit 'Respray' and 'Register'. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes), and use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the cost down (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: On the Spot
